notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Fallback harm liability wave
notable.line: Hospitals and pharmacies using European-hosted open fallback models face a coordinated wave of liability claims after dosage hallucinations cause documented patient harm, forcing courts to rule on who bears risk for emergency-switched models.

notable.title: Insurance capacity freeze
notable.line: Major EU insurers jointly suspend new cyber and AI-liability cover for uncertified public operators after fallback hallucinations cause patient-harm claims, freezing outsourcing deals until state backstop is clarified.

notable.title: Insurance withdrawal crunch
notable.line: Major European insurers jointly suspend new cyber and business-interruption cover for operators still dependent on withdrawn US models, triggering a short-term insurance crunch for hospitals and logistics firms.
